_readme: Curated records for flagship programmes whose sites block datacenter IPs (HTTP 403 on DAAD,
Chevening, Fulbright, campuschina, scholarshipdb from this sandbox — verified during build).
The bot fetches `verify_url` each run and overrides deadline / amount / IELTS when it can read
them, so these entries are a floor, not a guess.  Every record carries `review_before`; when that
date passes, the row is flagged `stale seed` in the report so you know to re-check the source.
Fields use the same names as parsers/fields.RawExtraction.

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarships (UK Government) — Pakistan
scholarships.amount_text: Fully funded: tuition + monthly living allowance + flights + visa + arrival/departure grants
scholarships.deadline_text: Applications open annually ~August, close early November
scholarships.eligibility: Pakistani citizens with an undergraduate degree, minimum 2800 hours (2 years) work experience, no previous study in the UK on a Chevening award, must return to Pakistan for 2 years.
scholarships.notes: One award per country per applicant; IELTS often waived for English-medium graduates but verify.

scholarships.title: Fulbright Master's Scholarships for Pakistan (EducationUSA)
scholarships.provider: US Department of State / EducationUSA Pakistan
scholarships.amount_text: Full funding: tuition, monthly stipend, round-trip airfare, accident & sickness cover, book allowance
scholarships.deadline_text: Usually closes in May for the following academic year
scholarships.eligibility: Pakistani citizens, domicile in Pakistan, bachelor's with good academic record, GRE usually required, not currently in the US.
scholarships.notes: GRE required for most fields; check ETS registration lead time (~2 months).

scholarships.title: DAAD EPOS Scholarships — Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (Germany)
scholarships.field: Engineering, Environment, Public Policy, Business, Health, Agriculture
scholarships.amount_text: €992/month (Master) or €1,300/month (PhD) + insurance + travel allowance; tuition usually free at public universities
scholarships.deadline_text: Deadlines vary per EPOS programme: typically Aug/Sep–Oct/Nov of the year before intake
scholarships.eligibility: Bachelor completed within the last 6 years, at least 2 years professional experience in a development-related field, admission to a listed EPOS master's programme.
scholarships.notes: Apply to the master's programme AND the DAAD scholarship; some EPOS courses require DSH/TestDaF German.

scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM) — full-cycle intake 2027-2028
scholarships.provider: European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA)
scholarships.country: Netherlands, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Sweden, Norway, Portugal
scholarships.field: Any (each programme defines its own field)
scholarships.amount_text: Full fees + living allowance of about €1,400/month for 24 months + travel/top-up costs
scholarships.deadline_text: Most EMJM programmes close between mid-December and end of January for the following September intake
scholarships.eligibility: Bachelor degree (or final year) in a related field, max 3 EMJM applications per call, no prior EMJM grant, English B2/C1.
scholarships.notes: Programme-specific deadlines! Check each consortium page; the catalogue filter is the ground truth.

scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) — Type A / Bilateral Program
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition + dorm + 3,000 CNY/month (Master) / 3,500 CNY/month (PhD) + medical insurance
scholarships.deadline_text: Usually 1 March – 31 April via the Chinese embassy in Islamabad or the university track
scholarships.eligibility: Under 35 for master's, under 40 for PhD, bachelor's degree, Chinese-taught programmes need HSK (English-taught do not).
scholarships.notes: Two routes: bilateral (Embassy/HEC Pakistan) and university-direct. Applying to both raises odds.

scholarships.title: Türkiye Bursları (Turkey Scholarships) — Graduate
scholarships.amount_text: University placement + monthly stipend + 1 year Turkish language course + accommodation + insurance + round-trip flights
scholarships.deadline_text: Applications open 10 January and close 20 February (annual)
scholarships.eligibility: Under 30 for master's, no more than 75% previous academic average typically required, no residence in Türkiye.
scholarships.notes: One of the few fully-funded options with no application fee and no IELTS for many programmes.

scholarships.title: MEXT (Monbukagakusho) Japanese Government Scholarship — Graduate
scholarships.provider: MEXT / Embassy of Japan in Pakistan
scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition + ¥143,000–148,000 per month + economy airfare + 6 months Japanese course
scholarships.deadline_text: Embassy (recommendation) track: screening tests in June/July, apply ~May
scholarships.eligibility: Under 35 as of 1 April of arrival year, bachelor's degree, Japanese or English proficiency depending on programme.
scholarships.notes: Two tracks: Embassy recommendation and University recommendation. No tuition fee for either.

scholarships.title: KGEP (Study in India) — Pakistan nationals, IITs / NITs / IIITs
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Education, Government of India
scholarships.amount_text: Monthly scholarship covering tuition at the admissible rate + ₹35,000/month for postgraduate
scholarships.deadline_text: Applications typically close in June for the July–August admission cycle
scholarships.eligibility: Pakistan nationals under 45, valid SAT/IELTS as applicable; admission is centrally allocated.
scholarships.notes: Check current diplomatic/visa feasibility before investing time — administrative steps vary by year.

scholarships.title: Stipendium Hungaricum (Hungary)
scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver + dormitory place or housing allowance + ~43,700 HUF/month stipend (master's)
scholarships.deadline_text: Opening mid-November, closing mid-January; Pakistani applicants may also have an HEC-side deadline
scholarships.eligibility: Age limits by level (typically ≤35 for PhD, ≤25 for master's), medical & law programmes have extra tests.
scholarships.notes: Does NOT fully cover living costs — pair with savings or a second application elsewhere.

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships (UK) — for developing Commonwealth countries
scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition + living stipend + airfare + visa + CSC top-up grants
scholarships.deadline_text: Applications via CSC UK close in December for the following September intake
scholarships.eligibility: Citizens of developing Commonwealth countries (Pakistan included), already hold an undergraduate degree, cannot currently study in the UK, need to demonstrate development impact.
scholarships.notes: You must secure (or apply for) university admission yourself; the CSC award is separate.

scholarships.title: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme (ISP)
scholarships.country: United Kingdom, Canada, USA, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Netherlands, Germany, France, Ireland, Egypt, India, Malaysia
scholarships.amount_text: 50% grant + 50% loan (up to a ceiling); awarded via AKDN offices in Pakistan
scholarships.deadline_text: Generally closes in March (applications via the local AKFC office, which sets its own date)
scholarships.eligibility: Under 30 for master's, admission to a ranked programme, no other funding available (need-based).
scholarships.notes: Half of the award is a repayable loan — the balance must come from elsewhere.

scholarships.title: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SIIS)
scholarships.field: Sustainability, Engineering, Public Policy, Health, Environment
scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition + SEK 12,000/month + travel grant + insurance + housing loan option
scholarships.deadline_text: SI opens in February; you must first apply via universityadmissions.se in the October–January round
scholarships.eligibility: Work experience (minimum 3,000 hours), leadership evidence, apply to a Swedish master's first.
scholarships.notes: Two-step process: university admission (universityadmissions.se, applies 15 Jan) THEN the SI application.

scholarships.title: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA) — Polish National Swierkosz / Banach & Scholarships for Pakistan
scholarships.amount_text: Monthly stipend (~4,000 PLN for master's track programs) + exemption from tuition + accommodation allowance
eligible_countries: Country programs vary — Poland's development program covers Pakistan in some rounds
scholarships.deadline_text: Programme-dependent; many NAWA calls close in March–July
scholarships.eligibility: Check the specific programme call — NAWA runs several with different country lists.
scholarships.notes: Verify the Pakistan eligibility list per call; NAWA changes it year to year.

scholarships.title: OBOR Scholarship (COMSATS University, Pakistan) — for international students
scholarships.amount_text: Up to 100% tuition waiver for students from Belt & Road countries
scholarships.deadline_text: Rolling with admission rounds (Fall intake closes ~August)
scholarships.eligibility: Admission offer to COMSATS plus GRE/NET or university test.
scholarships.notes: Local option — useful as a fallback if visa routes to Europe close.

scholarships.title: Swedish University (SI / University) scholarships — tuition waiver rounds
scholarships.deadline_text: Swedish admissions round for autumn: applications close 15 January
scholarships.eligibility: Apply through UniversityAdmissions.se; scholarship applications usually open right after admission.
scholarships.notes: Tuition waivers alone do not solve living costs — pair with a stipend award.

scholarships.title: Australian Awards Scholarships — Pakistan
scholarships.provider: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (Australia)
scholarships.field: Public Policy, Economics, Engineering, Health, Environment
scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition + living allowance + return air travel + startup allowance + pre-course English
scholarships.deadline_text: Pakistan round usually closes around April–June for the following year's intake
scholarships.eligibility: Australian development priorities, minimum 1 year work experience, not married to an Australian/NZ citizen.
scholarships.notes: Quota-based and development-impact focused; a strong CV matters more than GPA.

scholarships.title: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS-G) — Graduate, Embassy/University track
scholarships.provider: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Korea
scholarships.field: Any (priority to STEM and humanities-Korea studies)
scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition + ₩1,000,000/month + 1 year Korean language + airfare + settlement allowance
scholarships.deadline_text: Embassy track applications usually open August–September for the following year
scholarships.eligibility: Under 40, bachelor's with ≥80% (2.64/4.0) CGPA, no Korean citizenship, TOPIK or English scores.
scholarships.notes: Age and CGPA cut-offs are hard gates — computed against your profile automatically.
